payload.title: File:Ignotosaurus illium.png
payload.description_html: The holotype right ilium (PVSJ 884) of Ignotosaurus fragilis. The ilium is seen in dorsal view (from above; top) and lateral view (from the outer side; bottom). Note the square bracket ( [ ) shape of the ilium in dorsal view, this feature is unique to the genus. Arrow indicated anterior direction (towards the head)
